_comment: Ratchet table (R4): fixture dir -> anchor -> allowed audit() statuses, resolved document-scoped with the fixture's declared state. Authored from the real pack-v2 audit output (S2.3); 'ok'-everywhere is never the bar — legitimate absences are pinned here so they stop counting as drift. Dated dirs may never list broken/ambiguous (F3). Synthetic dirs are flagged via state.json's "_synthetic": true (F6), not here. _notes carries one reason per non-ok cell.

_notes.composerForm: real form carries no data-chatgpt-composer attr on purpose, to exercise strategy 2 (form:has([data-composer-markdown]):not([data-turn-key] form)); a decoy edit-mode form inside the first exchange is excluded by the :not() guard
_notes.composer: resolved inside the strategy-2-won composerForm; the decoy's composer-markdown div sits inside the decoy form, never inside the resolved composerForm, so it cannot match
_notes.sendButton: state composing: the real Send is inside the resolved composerForm; the decoy Send (type=submit aria-label=Send) is data-oracle-negative and excluded by inside:composerForm
_notes.responseActionBar: document-wide pick:last resolves the second (real) exchange's bar via strategy 1 (has-copy-and-more); the first exchange's Copy-less bar independently exercises strategy 2 (has-more-actions) via its own per-exchange resolve
_notes.copyResponseButton: resolved inside the document-wide responseActionBar (the real exchange's bar); the first exchange has no Copy button at all, exercising responseActionBar's Copy-less strategy without ever making copyResponseButton broken
